unit_book: 段考专题　高一上 · 第 1 站

overview.title: 这次段考考什么
overview.lead: 一格 = 一成的卷考到。**粗体**教材进度 = 考在教之前。
overview.after: 时态、被动语态每卷都考，初中已学，见同步讲义，本册不单讲。

topics.name: 虚拟语气

explain.text: 东莞这一站考虚拟，几乎只考一种：[[recommend]] 后接 that 从句，从句谓语用 [[(should) + 动词原形]]。题目常把它藏在两处：主语从句 [[It is recommended that …]]，或者要求把 [[recommend sb. to do]] 改写成从句。
recommend that sb. (should) do  |  It is recommended that sth. (should) be done
从句主语若是动作的承受者，套被动：[[(should) be done]]。should 可省，答案两种都给分；但 be 不能丢。

stem.text: It is highly recommended that the government ___ (take) measures to protect the environment.
stem.src: 2023 · 东莞外国语 · 高一上月考

examples.ju: 强烈建议政府采取措施保护环境。

mid.label: 成分
mid.text: that 从句是真正的主语，谓语空着；主句是 It is recommended，从句用虚拟。

stem.text: It is strongly recommended that the machines ___ (check) every year.
stem.src: 2024 · 东莞高中 · 高一上月考

examples.ju: 强烈建议每年检查这些机器。

mid.label: 成分
mid.text: 同上用虚拟；machines 是 check 的承受者，用被动。

topics.keypoint: 见 recommend that，从句谓语写 (should) + 原形；主语是物再加 be done。改写题把 recommend sb. to do 换成 recommend that sb. (should) do。

drill.stem: The expert recommended to do some research before carrying out the experiment.
drill.src: 2024 · 东莞市 · 高一上联考
drill.ans: The expert recommended that some research (should) be done before carrying out the experiment.
drill.why: research 是承受者，用 (should) be done。

drill.stem:
I recommend you to focus on what the teacher says.
I recommend ___ what the teacher says.
drill.src: 2024 · 东莞高中 · 高一上月考

drill.stem: Mrs Brown 建议我积极参加课外活动。
drill.src: 2023 · 石竹实验 · 高一上月考
drill.ans: Mrs Brown recommended that I (should) take an active part in after-class activities.

drill.stem:
What would happen if we didn’t get there on time?
___ we didn’t get there on time?
drill.src: 2024 · 东莞高中 · 高一上月考
drill.why: What if … = What would happen if …
